review_basis: Re-review of the JPEG-recompressed figure rebuild (figures converted from lossless PNG to JPEG q88, covers q92; PDFs recompiled with XeLaTeX). Poppler 90 DPI raster review of both covers, contents/front matter, ordinary text, code and table pages, chapter-opening artwork rendered through the .jpg-preferring \chapterart macro, appendix material, a chapter-end blank, and final pages. No clipping, missing glyphs, unintended overlap, broken layout, JPEG blocking, or gradient banding observed; dark-gradient covers and fine line-art figures were checked specifically because they are the most compression-sensitive content. Conducted by the Claude Code agent as an advisory technical observation; it is not a human publication or rights decision.
